# Crux IDE: product overview

Official site: https://codecrux.us/

Crux brings code editing, live collaboration, a spatial view of files, and a terminal into one workspace. The browser IDE is available at https://codecrux.us/ide. The desktop application is in preview; use the waitlist on the homepage to request access.

## Workflows
- Explore connected files on a spatial code canvas.
- Edit code with collaborators and see live presence.
- Keep terminal commands and coding tools beside the editor.
- Compare Crux with other coding tools at https://codecrux.us/compare.

## Technical context
The current web editing surface uses CodeMirror. Shared text state uses Yjs. The desktop package uses Tauri. These implementation details may change as the product develops.
